g.title: f_de4b365913
g.text: The Englishman lives in the red house.

g.title: f_36ee198f4b
g.text: The Norwegian lives in the first house.

g.title: f_1ad51ff312
g.text: The Old Gold smoker owns snails.

g.title: f_028faf5d66
g.text: Coffee is drunk in the green house.

g.title: f_3ba0df4fb8
g.text: Milk is drunk in the middle house.

g.title: f_37403dc8a1
g.text: The Lucky Strike smoker drinks orange juice.

g.title: f_4050b3f49e
g.text: Kools are smoked in the yellow house.

g.title: f_f2482ffe37
g.text: The green house is immediately to the right of the ivory house.

g.title: f_ed082603b6
g.text: The man who smokes Chesterfields lives in the house next to the man with the fox.

g.title: f_e2afbbd91f
g.text: The Norwegian lives next to the blue house.

g.title: f_bd2a33efb7
g.text: Kools are smoked in the house next to the house where the horse is kept.
